description: A firm by name (Binance, OKX, Wintermute, Jump Trading, a16z…): what kind it is, how many addresses are labelled as its own and by whom, for exchanges the assets in their published wallets with net flows over 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days (DefiLlama), and the top tokens where it is among the ten largest holders, with share and value. Use for exchange reserves and outflows, what a market maker or fund holds, or which addresses belong to a firm.

lang.description: Language of the text answer: en or ru

name.description: A firm’s name or id, e.g. "Binance", "Wintermute"

name: who_is

alike.description: Names that contain the query, when none matches exactly

addresses.description: Labelled addresses; 0 for an exchange known only by its reserves

basis.description: How sure the name is. exchange: the exchange lists these wallets as its own; corroborated: two label sets agree; curated: Dune’s curated tables alone; community: the eth-labels community set alone: not confirmed

holds.description: Top tokens where its addresses are among the ten largest holders, most dollars first

items.description: A top token where the firm or address is among the ten largest holders.

share.description: Share of the token’s total supply, 0 to 1, summed over its addresses among the ten largest holders

usd.description: That share at the token’s price, in US dollars; null when not read

kind.description: What kind of firm it is. exchange: a centralised exchange: tokens sent there are usually about to be sold or were just bought; marketMaker: a market maker: its moves to and from exchanges are its trade; custody: a custodian holding tokens for clients; fund: an investment fund; exploiter: an address named as a theft’s; the venue in its name is the victim

name.description: Its name as the sources spell it

anyOf.description: An exchange’s reserves and flows, from DefiLlama’s reading of its published wallets.

in24h.description: Net flow into those wallets over 24 hours, in US dollars; null when not read

in30d.description: Net flow over 30 days, in US dollars; null when not read

in7d.description: Net flow over 7 days, in US dollars; null when not read

usd.description: Assets in its published wallets, its own token left out, in US dollars

wallets.description: Where the exchange lists its wallets; null when unknown

sources.description: Who named its addresses. reserves: the exchange’s own published wallet list, via DefiLlama; dune: Dune’s curated exchange tables; community: the eth-labels community set

items.description: Who named the address. reserves: the exchange’s own published wallet list, via DefiLlama; dune: Dune’s curated exchange tables; community: the eth-labels community set

title: A firm on-chain
